pat: heads-up: drafting a concise BYOK emergency runbook + quarterly drill plan. want quick feedback before I put it in infra repo. Key goals: preserve customer custody guarantees where possible, minimize vendor-dependent blockers, and make every emergency actuation auditable.

rachel: please clarify what you mean by "preserve custody": we can't exfil KEKs. are we talking about vendor-to-vendor HSM rewraps only?

pat: yes vendor-to-vendor HSM rewraps / in-HSM key-to-key wrap when possible. fallback is ephemeral unwrap in a locked bastion but only with JIT 2-person auth + customer opt-in flag.

kyle: proposed constraints:
- JIT role `byok_rewrap_jit` with TTL <= 1h
- two distinct approvers from SRE + Sec/Legal for swapped-host runs
- recording: full-screen capture + command audit stored to immutable bucket `s3://byok-audit/emergency/YYYYMMDD/`

emily: logging fields to send to SIEM: `event=byok_rewrap`, `account_id`, `key_alias`, `operator`, `approver`, `jit_role_id`, `host_image`, `agent_version`, `swap_enabled`, `metadata_sha256`, `video_url`. Mark `sensitivity=high`.

legal: quick legal note: customers must opt in during onboarding for any operator actuation. If customer declines, we fall back to best-effort vendor escalation and notify PD/Sales. We can include an exception clause for lawful orders. I'll draft opt-in text.

pat: drill mechanics idea:
1) pre-drill: choose a non-prod tenant + set `byok_emergency_optin=true`
2) trigger vendor blackout simulation (coord with partnerships)
3) SRE requests JIT role via auth service; approver must be another oncall + legal/affairs reps for test
4) run harmless rewrap to a test HSM slot; capture artifacts; validate SIEM ingests and audit retention
5) 24h: retrospective and update runbooks

rachel: suggestion: add a safety kill-switch: any rewrap that touches prod prefix must auto-abort unless `incident_severity >= P1` and signed PD ticket is attached.

kyle: technical: helper must mlock all pages, use tmpfs for ephemeral blobs, and run with CAP_IPC_LOCK. CI must include memory-leak checks and denylist core generation on the host.

ops-bot: Reminder: policy BYOK-EMG-1 requires audit retention >= 5y for enterprise tenants. See https://policies.internal/byok-emg-1

emily: compliance nuance: video storage encryption MUST use a separate KMS key and HSM-protected wrap; no videos on general S3 buckets. Also recommend tamper-evident manifests (signed and hashed).

legal: also require customer notification timeline: notify within 12h of emergency run and provide evidence packet in 72h. We'll add this to the contract addendum.

pat: I'll draft the runbook + PR to infra with a checklist and the drill schedule. Will include a minimal JSON schema for SIEM events so ingestion is consistent. pinging @rachel @kyle for review. :thumbsup:

rachel: will do a quick pass tomorrow morning.

kyle: will add memory/privilege tests to CI.

compliance-bot: Action item created: TASK-8891 (quarterly BYOK drill) assigned to @pat.

pat: thanks all. keeping thread short. I'll drop links to PR + runbook when ready. :white_check_mark:
